fees.conditions: 1 cabin bag plus 1 small personal item. Economy/Premium Economy: 7 kg; Business/First: 10 kg.

data_quality.notes: Air India publishes excess cabin-baggage charges when cabin baggage must be checked: domestic INR 3000 or international USD 75 if the combined checked allowance is exceeded.

fees.conditions: Included allowance depends on route, cabin, fare family, status, and whether the itinerary uses weight or piece concept

data_quality.notes: For Air India, the ticketed allowance matters more than a generic airline-wide rule. Interline and codeshare itineraries can follow another carrier’s baggage rules.

fees.amount: From INR 700 per kg domestic; from USD 17 per kg international weight concept
fees.conditions: Excess is per kg on weight routes and per piece/heavy piece on piece routes; prepaid excess can save money
fees.applies_to: All fares (where additional bags are permitted)

data_quality.notes: Domestic India excess baggage is published as INR 700/kg before taxes. International weight-concept rates vary by region; piece-concept markets such as USA/Canada use per-piece tables.

fees.amount: Depends on route; piece-concept heavy bags charged above 23 kg
fees.conditions: Overweight charges depend on baggage concept; piece-route bags are charged above 23 kg and cannot exceed 32 kg.

data_quality.notes: Air India publishes separate weight-concept per-kg rates and piece-concept heavy-piece rules, so one flat overweight number would be misleading.

fees.amount: Depends on route, size, and aircraft
fees.conditions: Oversize fees depend on route, aircraft handling, and whether the item is normal checked baggage or special baggage.

data_quality.notes: Oversize handling is not a single universal fee; Air India points passengers to excess-baggage and special-baggage rules based on route and item.

fees.conditions: Maharaja Club adds baggage: Silver gets 5 kg on weight concept; Gold/Platinum get 20 kg or 1 extra 23 kg piece
fees.applies_to: Maharaja Club Silver, Gold, and Platinum members
fees.region_or_route: Air India and eligible Star Alliance routes

data_quality.notes: Silver applies on Air India only; Gold and Platinum have Star Alliance eligibility where the fare has free baggage allowance.

fees.conditions: Sports equipment counts toward free allowance, but a route-based special-handling fee can apply
fees.applies_to: Sports equipment accepted as checked baggage
fees.timing: airport / pre-book at least 6 hours before departure

data_quality.notes: Handling fee can be waived for eligible Flex and Business fares when sports equipment is pre-booked; airport purchases do not get the waiver.

fees.conditions: Infant cabin items up to 5 kg may include food, feeding bottles, and a carry-on tote for food and bottles
